turns.text: Hi there! Looks like the train is delayed by twenty minutes. Are you heading into the city for work today?
Yeah, I'm commuting to the office downtown. How about you, are you traveling for work or heading home?
Just heading to meet an old university friend for coffee. It's been years since we caught up.
That sounds really nice. Where are you planning to go for coffee in the city?
A little place near the botanical gardens called Green Leaf. Have you ever been around that area?
Oh, actually I got a plant from there last summer! But anyway, yes, Green Leaf has fantastic pastries.
Glad to hear that, I will make sure to try their almond croissants.
Their almond croissants are definitely the highlight. Do you often take this train line?
Only when visiting this side of town. The commute feels longer with the signal works today.
Definitely. Hopefully the platform display updates with good news soon.
